tasks.label: Silk: Run current file
tasks.detail: Compile the active .silk file with build-exe (source root = its directory) and run it.
tasks.command: out=$(mktemp -t silk-run) && node "${workspaceFolder}/packages/compiler-cli/dist/bin.js" build-exe "${file}" --source-root "${fileDirname}" --output "$out" && "$out"; echo "exit: $?"; rm -f "$out"
